# OpenHormozi

> Map of the business concepts Alex Hormozi teaches, built from 1,058 public videos. 1,434 concepts, each with a short summary, verified quotes and timestamped video links. Unofficial, not affiliated with or endorsed by Alex Hormozi.

No sign-in or API key. Everything here is static files. Fetch them relative to this file's URL.

## How to use

- Start with the topic file closest to the question. Each is plain Markdown, most-cited concepts first.
- For lookups or filtering, load concepts.json: {meta, concepts:[{id, name, topic, type, source_count, summary, related, quotes:[{text, video_title, timestamp, url}]}]}.
- When you use a quote, keep its attribution and video link.

## Accuracy

- Summaries are machine-written paraphrases. Only text under `quotes` is his words.
- Quotes were matched word for word against YouTube auto-captions, so numbers and names can be garbled. Check the timestamp before relying on one.

## Install

- Paste into any AI assistant: `Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zqxuii/OpenHormozi/main/SETUP.md and follow it to set up a Hormozi business agent for me.`
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add zqxuii/OpenHormozi` then `/plugin install open-hormozi --marketplace zqxuii/OpenHormozi`
- npx: `npx openhormozi skill`, `npx openhormozi agent`, `npx openhormozi live` (live brain board), `npx openhormozi search <term>`
- Agent instructions only: https://www.akshaymenon.qd.je/agent.md
- Source: https://github.com/zqxuii/OpenHormozi

## Data

- [concepts.json](concepts.json): all 1,434 concepts as JSON
